The Trump administration is considering a new childcare subsidy that would help some married couples afford to have one parent stay home to care for their children. Under the proposed plan, one spouse would need to work at least 35 hours a week, while the other stays home - but single parents and unmarried couples would not qualify. The money would come from an existing federal childcare fund that already helps lower- and middle-income families cover the cost of care, rather than creating an entirely new program. Supporters say the proposal could give parents more choice, while critics warn it could leave single working parents with less support and take funding away from traditional childcare providers. #childcare #trump #usa #news #family

Description: This video features a historical interview with Donald Trump reflecting on the aftermath of the 9/11 attacks and the destruction at the World Trade Center. He discusses the enormous scale of the devastation and the difficult task of clearing the site, recovering victims, and beginning the rebuilding process. Drawing from his background in New York real estate, Trump comments on the engineering and logistical challenges involved in the recovery. He also highlights the efforts of workers, first responders, volunteers, and businesses that contributed to the cleanup and recovery at Ground Zero. The interview also focuses on the human impact of the attacks, including the grief experienced by victims’ families and the resilience shown by New Yorkers and people across the country. The discussion reflects the widespread desire to support those affected and help the city recover during an extraordinary national crisis. Overall, the footage offers a historical look at the atmosphere following 9/11, capturing the uncertainty, grief, determination, and sense of unity that shaped the immediate aftermath of the attacks. #DonaldTrump #911 #viral #politics #tiktok
